The difference between the average number of students per college in commerce and the average number of students per stream in college 2 (Correct to 2 decimal places) is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

The average number of students per college in commerce, (2200 + 2400 + 2250 + 3250)/ 4 = 2525

The average number of students per stream in college 2 ,( 1800 + 1700 +2400) = 1966.67

The difference will be 2525 - 1966.67 = 558.3
